caption: Per-gait stamina flow: a lone Infantry regiment (drill, no enemy) is ordered to Jog a long leg south and then, still mid-jog, re-ordered to Sprint to a fresh destination. Watch the stat sheet's new 'Stamina per man' readout (bottom-left): it holds at 100 while the men stand and reform, bleeds slowly through the jog leg (about 1 point a second, 100 down to 93), then drops steeply once the sprint order takes (about five points a second at full sprint, slower during the ramp and braking, 93 down to 63 by arrival, the last few points shed as it brakes through a jog and then a neutral walk over the final stretch). A walk is neutral and a halt regenerates, so movement now prices only the paces that cost real soldiers something.
